jobs.job_description: Acesoft Labs (India) Pvt Ltd in Dubai invites a skilled Data Engineer to design, develop and maintain scalable data pipelines using PySpark, Spark, Python and SQL. You will build ETL/ELT processes on cloud data platforms and Databricks, with exposure to data lakes and lakehouses. The role requires hands-on data engineering experience, strong problem solving, and collaboration with data scientists and analysts in a multicultural environment.

AffirmedRx in Dubai is seeking a data professional to monitor daily Snowflake loads, file ingestion, and scheduled jobs to keep data processes running smoothly. You will build tables, views, and dbt models, assist Snowflake administration, and document pipelines under the Data Warehouse Manager. This role requires 10–20% travel and familiarity with healthcare data. Join a growing health tech team delivering impact in a dynamic environment.

About us

Bayut & dubizzle have the unique distinction of being iconic, homegrown brands with a strong presence across the seven emirates in the UAE. Connecting millions of users across the country, we are committed to delivering the best online search experience.

As part of Dubizzle Group, we are alongside some of the strongest classified brands in the market. With a collective strength of 5 brands, we have more than 123 million monthly users that trust in our dedication to providing them with the best platform for their needs.

Role overview

The Data Engineer intern will be participating in exciting projects covering the end-to-end data lifecycle – from raw data integrations with primary and third-party systems, through advanced data modelling, to state-of-the-art data visualisation and development of innovative data products.

You will have the opportunity to learn how to build and work with both batch and real-time data processing pipelines. You will work in a modern cloud-based data warehousing environment alongside a team of diverse, intense and interesting co-workers. You will liaise with other departments – such as product & tech, the core business verticals, trust & safety, finance and others – to enable them to be successful.

Responsibilities

• Raw data integrations with primary and third-party systems

• Data warehouse modelling for operational and application data layers

• Development in Amazon Redshift cluster

• SQL development as part of agile team workflow

• ETL design and implementation in Matillion ETL

• Design and implementation of data products enabling data-driven features or business solutions

• Data quality, system stability and security

• Coding standards in SQL, Python, ETL design

• Data dashboards and advanced visualisations in Periscope Data with a focus on UX, simplicity and usability

• Working with other departments on data products – i.e. product & technology, marketing & growth, finance, core business, advertising and others

• Being part and contributing towards a strong team culture and ambition to be on the cutting edge of big data

Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, math, physics or any related quantitative field

• Knowledge of relational and dimensional data models

• Knowledge of terminal operations and Linux workflows

• Ability to communicate insights and findings to a non-technical audience

• Good SQL skills across a variety of relational data warehousing technologies especially in cloud data warehousing (e.g. Amazon Redshift, Google BigQuery, Snowflake, Vertica, etc.)

• Attention to details and analytical thinking

• Entrepreneurial spirit and ability to think creatively; highly-driven and self-motivated; strong curiosity and strive for continuous learning

Benefits

• Ability to contribute to a platform used by more than 5 million users in UAE and other platforms in the region

• Strengthen your resume and build your network

• Opportunity to find a full-time career with the region's leading organization

• Working in a multicultural environment with over 60 different nationalities

• Access to the learning & development tools and courses provided by the company

Bayut & dubizzle is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Head of Engineering, Data & AI

Location: Dubai, UAE

Employment: Full-time | On-site

Reports to: Founder & CEO

This Is Not a Traditional Head of Engineering Role

You won't inherit a large engineering organization, multiple managers and established processes.

You will help build them.

AskEddy is looking for an exceptional hands-on technology leader who can move between architecture, code, AI, infrastructure, cybersecurity, product and leadership — sometimes in the same day.

We are looking for someone ambitious, technically exceptional and highly curious. You should be capable of leading engineers — but you should also still love building.

If your preferred leadership style is primarily managing managers, attending meetings and delegating technical execution, this probably isn't the role for you.

The technology decisions we make today will help determine what this company can become tomorrow.

If you want to take real ownership of a technology platform, help build the engineering organization around it, and have the ambition to build something genuinely big from an early stage — keep reading.

About AskEddy

AskEddy is a UAE-based AI-powered technology startup building a new way for people and companies to discover, plan and book — from activities and entertainment to wellness and team experiences.

Our platform combines an AI-powered consumer experience with a growing B2B ecosystem serving companies and their employees.

At the centre of the product is AI — our intelligent concierge designed to understand what users want, recommend relevant experiences, build personalized plans and ultimately help users move from discovery to booking.

But our ambition goes beyond putting AI inside the product.

We Are Building a Company for the AI Era

Most companies are trying to introduce AI into structures that already exist.

We have the opportunity to start differently.

AskEddy is being built from the beginning as a lean, technology-first and AI-native organization.

Our goal isn't to replace great people with AI. It is to give exceptional people extraordinary leverage.

We want AI agents and intelligent automation embedded throughout the organization — across engineering, finance, operations, customer support, business development, sales, marketing and beyond.

That means we're not simply asking:

“How can AI improve the company we already built?”

We're asking:

“If we were building this company today, with everything AI makes possible, how should it be built?”

We are a fresh, ambitious team building at a moment when the rules of how technology companies operate are being rewritten.

And our Head of Engineering, Data & AI will play a major role in answering that question.

We are preparing for launch and are now looking for the technology leader who can help take AskEddy through the next stage of its journey.

The Role

As Head of Engineering, Data & AI, you will take ownership of AskEddy's technology function.

You will work directly with the Founder & CEO and take responsibility for the technology behind our products, systems and future engineering organization.

Your mandate spans:

Engineering. Architecture. AI. Data. Cybersecurity. Cloud Infrastructure. DevOps. Technology Operations.

This is a leadership position — but it is deliberately hands-on.

When something breaks, you should be capable of understanding why.

When architecture needs changing, you should be capable of designing it.

When code needs reviewing, you should understand it.

When necessary, you should be capable of getting into the code yourself.

When we want to introduce a new AI capability, your first instinct should be to figure out how we can build it.

What You Will Own

1. Engineering & Product Technology

Take technical ownership of AskEddy's consumer application, backend, Admin/Vendor Portal and supporting systems.

Own engineering quality, architecture, performance, reliability and scalability.

Review and improve the existing codebase.

Personally troubleshoot complex technical problems when necessary.

Build and ship new product features alongside the engineering team when required.

Translate product requirements into technical solutions and establish strong engineering standards.

2. AI & AI Agents

Take ownership of the technical development and evolution of AI.

Evaluate and implement LLMs, AI APIs and emerging technologies where they create genuine business value.

Build AI agents, intelligent workflows, personalization, recommendation and conversational capabilities.

But your AI responsibility doesn't stop with the product.

You will also help us identify and implement AI agents across the company, automating workflows and increasing productivity across departments.

We want someone who constantly asks:

“Could AI do this better?”

3. Architecture & Scalability

Own the technical architecture of the platform.

Evaluate the existing architecture and identify technical debt, scalability limitations and security risks.

Design systems capable of supporting AskEddy as it moves from launch to growth and larger-scale operations.

Make pragmatic architectural decisions appropriate for a startup — avoiding both dangerous technical debt and unnecessary enterprise complexity.

4. Cloud, Infrastructure & DevOps

Own the reliability and scalability of our cloud infrastructure, including deployments, monitoring, backups and disaster recovery.

Improve CI/CD, performance, cost efficiency and production resilience.

Our existing infrastructure is primarily built around AWS, so strong cloud experience is important.

5. Cybersecurity

Own AskEddy's technical security posture, including data protection, access controls, authentication, secrets management, vulnerability management and incident preparedness.

Ensure security becomes part of engineering rather than something considered after development.

6. Data

Establish reliable data foundations for analytics, personalization, AI and management reporting.

7. Engineering Leadership

Take technical ownership of our existing outsourced development resources and establish accountability for quality, delivery, architecture, security, testing and timelines.

As AskEddy grows, help build the internal engineering organization around the company's needs.

You will participate directly in hiring engineers and technical specialists.

We want you to build a high-performance engineering culture from the beginning.

Who We Are Looking For

We care much more about what you can actually do than how impressive your job titles sound.

You are likely someone who has built substantial software products and is now ready to take broader ownership.

You may currently be a:

Senior Software Engineer/ Tech Lead, Engineering Lead/ Engineering Manager/ Head of Engineering, or similar technical leader.

You should have:
• 7+ years of strong software engineering/technology experience
• Experience leading engineers, technical projects or engineering delivery
• Strong software engineering fundamentals
• Strong backend and systems architecture experience
• Ability to read, review, debug and write production code
• Experience designing APIs and distributed/backend systems
• Strong database and data architecture knowledge
• Strong AWS/cloud experience
• CI/CD and DevOps understanding
• Practical cybersecurity knowledge
• Strong understanding of modern AI technologies
• Practical experience with LLMs, AI APIs, AI agents or AI-powered applications
• Strong problem-solving ability

Marketplace, payments, recommendation-system or consumer-app experience is highly valuable.

What Matters More Than Your CV

You Are a Builder

You enjoy creating things, not simply managing people who create them.

You Are Extremely Curious

Technology and AI move quickly, and so do you.

You Take Ownership

Why Join AskEddy?

The important decisions are happening now.

How we architect the platform. How we build AI. How AI agents operate across the company. How we use data. How we approach security. How we scale. And ultimately, how we build the technology organization itself.

Our ambition is not to build another small marketplace.

We want to build a category-defining technology company from the UAE and scale it internationally.

Join early enough that, when we build AskEddy into what we believe it can become, your fingerprints will be all over it.

Location

This is a full-time, on-site position in Dubai, UAE. This is not a remote role.

Compensation & Benefits

Up to AED 40,000 per month, depending on experience and capabilities.

The employment package includes:
• UAE employment visa
• Medical insurance
• Visa and medical insurance coverage for eligible spouse and dependants
• Annual flight ticket / travel allowance
• Annual leave and UAE public holidays
• End-of-service benefits in accordance with UAE employment regulations

Come build AskEddy with us.

Important — Application Form Required

To be considered for this role, please complete the short AskEddy application form below before submitting your LinkedIn application.

The form includes a few questions about your technical experience, AI/LLM exposure, startup mindset, and salary expectations.
